battery_metric: mean across vehicles of initial battery minus route energy
legend: boxed upper-left inside a reserved data-free y-axis band
vehicle_time_cdf: monotone interpolation of the pooled active-vehicle empirical CDF over the 24 hourly runs
vehicle_energy_cdf: monotone interpolation of the pooled active-vehicle energy empirical CDF over the 24 hourly runs
vehicle_kde_cdfs: zero-boundary-reflected Gaussian KDE-CDFs using a common pooled Scott bandwidth for each metric
